scenarios.title: Installation looks like a normal pip install
scenarios.expected: imported from site-packages (not a source checkout); version matches pip metadata; `pip check` clean; import is quick
scenarios.observed: v0.6.0 from /home/claude/seggnosis_work/benchmarks/.cache/user_venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/seggnosis; pip check clean; cold import incl. torch 2.71s

scenarios.title: README quickstart: wrap(...).predict(image)
scenarios.expected: Result has mask/probs/uncertainty_map/confidence with sane shapes, ranges and summary()

scenarios.title: Every method x every uncertainty type runs
Batch of images
scenarios.expected: (B,H,W) mask and a length-B confidence array; TTA batch == per-image calls
scenarios.observed: mask(5, 32, 32) confidence(5,); identical to per-image predictions

scenarios.title: 3-D volumes (spatial_dims=3)
scenarios.expected: all three methods work on (C,D,H,W) and (B,C,D,H,W) volumes
scenarios.observed: mc_dropout, tta, ensemble OK on single and batched volumes

scenarios.title: OOD detection through result.is_ood
scenarios.expected: normal images rarely flagged (<=20%), 4x-noise images almost always (>=80%); save/load gives identical scores
scenarios.observed: false alarms 7%, shifted detected 100%; save/load round-trip identical

scenarios.title: Temperature scaling on an overconfident model
scenarios.expected: ECE drops by >=30%, accuracy unchanged, save/load round-trips

scenarios.title: Conformal prediction (LAC / APS / RAPS)
scenarios.expected: coverage >= target - 1pt for all three scores; helpful error if predict() is called before calibrate()
scenarios.observed: lac: cov 0.961, size 1.00; aps: cov 0.996, size 1.78; raps: cov 0.988, size 1.26 | error before calibrate: "Call .calibrate(calibration_data) before .predict() -- the conformal t..."

scenarios.title: Whole-image classification API
scenarios.expected: classification() works for all methods incl. OOD attachment
scenarios.observed: mc_dropout->class 3; tta->class 3; ensemble->class 3; OOD attached OK

scenarios.title: Mistakes produce clear, specific error messages
scenarios.expected: each misuse raises ValueError/RuntimeError with a message (not a cryptic internal error)
scenarios.observed: 13/13 misuse cases raise a clear error

scenarios.title: The user's model is left untouched by predict()
scenarios.expected: train/eval mode, parameters and gradients unchanged after every method
scenarios.observed: mode, weights and grads unchanged for 4 methods x {eval, train} starting states

scenarios.title: Determinism
scenarios.expected: TTA/ensemble reproducible; MC-dropout stochastic but reproducible under a seed
scenarios.observed: tta/ensemble identical across calls; mc_dropout differs between calls, identical with torch.manual_seed

scenarios.title: Documentation is present
scenarios.expected: every public name has a docstring

scenarios.title: Visualization helpers produce figures
scenarios.expected: overlay_uncertainty / plot_mask_comparison / reliability diagram run and save
